title: 假补丁实验的提交链条
issue: 论题断言（2021 年 4 月、明尼苏达研究组、匿名账号投递“伪君子提交”）获一手支撑：Greg KH 回退系列封面信逐字“Commits from @umn.edu addresses have been found to be submitted in 'bad faith' to try to test the kernel community's ability to review”，并引论文原题“Open Source Insecurity: Stealthily Introducing Vulnerabilities via Hypocrite Commits”（Qiushi Wu、Kangjie Lu）；LWN 854064、854645 均为 2021 年 4 月报道。

title: 维护者信任的紧急冻结
issue: “整组提交被要求回退重审”逐字核实：“all submissions from this group must be reverted from the kernel tree and will need to be re-reviewed again to determine if they actually are a valid fix”（Greg KH 回退封面信 2021-04-21；LWN 854064 同文在案）。

title: 190 件补丁的全量回退
issue: “Kroah-Hartman 以 190 件补丁的系列尽可能回退”逐字核实：系列题“[PATCH 000/190] Revertion of all of the umn.edu commits”（2021-04-21，署名 Greg Kroah-Hartman (190):）；LWN 854645 逐字“a 190-part patch series reverting as many patches from UMN as he could find”。

title: 人工复查与坏件清点
issue: “42 件坏补丁、约 22% 坏件率”逐字核实（LWN 854645）：“The 42 bad patches out of 190 is a 22% bad-patch rate.”；封面信另载“68 remaining ones that need to be manually reviewed”印证人工复查面。

title: 实验伦理的审稿缺口
issue: “超载的维护者无力逐件核验”逐字核实（LWN 854645）：“kernel maintainers (and maintainers of many other free-software projects) are overworked and do not have the time to properly review every patch”；伦理审查缺口见 LWN 854064 评论区对 IRB 未按人类研究处理的讨论。

title: TAB 介入与调查序列
issue: “技术顾问委员会接手核查”逐字核实（Kees Cook 代表 TAB，2021-04-22）：“The LF Technical Advisory Board is taking a look at the history of UMN's contributions and their associated research projects.”

title: 复查收尾与遗留补丁
issue: “复查收尾时仍有数十件补丁待移出主线”逐字核实（LWN 854645）：“if your editor's count is correct, 42 patches are still set to be pulled out of the kernel.”——42 与“数十件”密合。

title: 主线并入的暂缓处置
issue: “暂缓到合并窗口末尾统一处理”逐字核实（LWN 854645）：“Thus far, none of these patches have actually been reverted in the mainline; that seems likely to happen toward the end of the 5.13 merge window.”

title: 信任赤字的长期代价
issue: “补丁若普遍不可信，开发流程本身难以维持”逐字核实（LWN 854645）：“The kernel development process is, arguably, barely sustainable when that trust is well placed; it will not hold together if incoming patches cannot, in general, be trusted.”

title: AI 标注规则的成形
issue: “Assisted-by 标签成为补丁脚注的新格式”核实：官方文档《AI Coding Assistants》（coding-assistants.html）在档，其 2026-10 移除补丁逐字保留原格式行“ Assisted-by: LLM [TOOL1] [TOOL2]”与“Contributions should include an Assisted-by tag in the following format”；起草方引文与文档历史文本相符（现行页面格式段已在移除流程中，特注）。

title: 署名认证的人类专属
issue: “来源认证只能由人签署”逐字核实（coding-assistants.html）：“AI agents MUST NOT add Signed-off-by tags. Only humans can legally certify the Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO).”

title: 贡献责任的归属链条
issue: “提交者须对机器生成的代码负全责”逐字核实（coding-assistants.html）：人类提交者负责“Reviewing all AI-generated code”并“Taking full responsibility for the contribution”。

title: 内存安全论据的量化结构
issue: “把内核缺陷按类别归到 C 语言的边角行为”逐字核实（Greg KH，2025-02-19，Re: Rust kernel policy 线）：“The majority of bugs (quantity, not quality/severity) we have are due to the stupid little corner cases in C that are totally gone in Rust. Things like simple overwrites of memory..., error path cleanups, forgetting to check error values, and use-after-free mistakes.”

title: 语言稳定性的共同体担忧
issue: “三十年老项目经不起新语言与新习惯的连带冲击”逐字核实（LWN 987712 评论，corbet）：“how do you integrate a new language and new ways of doing things into a 30-year-old project that you cannot afford to break”。〔风格归一 2026-11-03：语言稳定性的社区担忧→语言稳定性的共同体担忧〕

title: 维护性反对的真实边界
issue: “反对意见多落在适配与长期维护成本”逐字核实（LWN 987712，corbet）：“There is opposition to merging Rust code just because it's Rust, without ensuring that it fits well into the kernel and that the result will be maintainable”。

title: 6.1 首并的实验定位
issue: “Rust 支持在 6.1 版本首次并入主线，官方口径定位为后续版本持续改进的起点”逐字核实（kernelnewbies Linux_6.1）：6.1 发布于 2022-12-11，“This release includes some initial support for Rust, which will be improved in later releases.”

title: 抽象层的移植纪律
issue: “Rust 侧不得绕过内核封装层直接调用 C 接口，未移植的 API 须先行移植”逐字核实（rust.docs.kernel.org/kernel/）：“This crate contains the kernel APIs that have been ported or wrapped for usage by Rust code in the kernel”＋“If you need a kernel C API that is not ported or wrapped yet here, then do so first instead of bypassing this crate.”

title: 弃用声明的士气冲击
issue: “无力于非技术噪音”逐字核实（LWN 987635，2024-08-29）：“After almost 4 years, I find myself lacking the energy and enthusiasm I once had to respond to some of the nontechnical nonsense, so it's best to leave it up to those who still have it in them.”——Wedson Almeida Filho 退出 Rust for Linux 项目。

title: 峰会议程的分诊职能
issue: “存储与内存管理峰会为文件系统 Rust 之争安排专场讨论”逐字核实（LWN 987635）：文中指认“Rust for filesystems discussion”视频出自 2024 Linux Storage, Filesystem, Memory-Management, and BPF Summit。

title: 安全披露的协调渠道
issue: “走私密发行版列表、公开披露走 oss-security”逐字核实（security-bugs.html）：“Coordination is usually handled by the 'linux-distros' mailing list and disclosure by the public 'oss-security' mailing list”。

title: 硬件漏洞的专用流程
issue: “硬件安全问题由专职团队在密室开发修复，与常规安全团队分立”逐字核实（embargoed-hardware-issues.html）：“The team only handles developing fixes for embargoed hardware security issues.”＋“The Linux kernel hardware security team is separate from the regular Linux kernel security team.”

title: 披露时限的弹性条款
issue: “禁运期可应报告者或受影响方请求展期至多 7 天”逐字核实（security-bugs.html）：披露日期“may be postponed at the request of the reporter or an affected party for up to 7 calendar days from the start” of the release process。

title: 构建不受损的默认规则
issue: “已知会破坏构建（含 Rust 侧）的变更默认不得合入”逐字核实（rust-for-linux.com/rust-kernel-policy）：“So, by default, changes should not be introduced if they are known to break the build, including Rust.”

title: 逐步参与的扩展策略
issue: “维护者的吸纳被设计为渐进过程，一次性铺开无法持续”逐字核实（rust-for-linux.com/rust-kernel-policy）：“The goal has always been to get maintainers involved progressively, because the effort does not scale otherwise.”

title: 宣告体例的评语结构
issue: “-mm 宣告以逐补丁评语加补丁清单为固定体例”经原始宣告核实：Andrew Morton《2.6.15-rc5-mm2》（2005-12-11）逐字“All 1164 patches:”下接逐补丁评语行（如“+sched-add-sched_batch-policy.patch — New CPU scheduler policy”），并附 patch-list 链接。

title: 补丁体量的编年刻度
issue: “每版宣告以补丁总数计量体量”逐字核实：同一宣告首列“All 1164 patches:”，另一宣告《2.6.16-rc1-mm5》首列“All 869 patches:”——计数体例为宣告固定栏目。

title: git 子树的收放节奏
issue: “宣告评语记录子树的纳入与弃置”逐字核实：rc5-mm2 宣告列“git-sym2.patch”“git-powerpc.patch”等树行，rc1-mm5 宣告设“Git trees”栏目列“git-alsa.patch”“git-kbuild.patch”等约二十余树。

title: 已知问题的预警栏目
issue: “宣告固定列出已知破损”核实：rc1-mm5 宣告设已知问题栏，逐字“WARNING: vmlinux: duplicate symbol '__down_interruptible' previous definition was in vmlinux”并言“You'll see something like this”——预警栏目在案。

title: 稳定分支的并行动作
issue: 编目设计题：论题为节内“-mm 宣告与 stable 发布双轨收载”的料件组织框架，无外涉事实断言；离线核查通过——上位节题与 outline.txt 相符，同节题族同粒度（T1／S2／S3）。

title: 末版 2.2 的告别宣告
issue: “2.2.26 以‘2.2 is not dead’为题发布末版并附安全修复清单”逐字核实：主题行“Linux 2.2.26 aka "2.2 is not dead" released”（Marc-Christian Petersen，2004-02-25），正文“so here we go, 2.2.26 final.”并劝升级，安全清单含“CAN-2004-0077”“CAN-2003-0984”“CAN-2003-0244”逐条在列。

title: 破损实录的自述形式
issue: “后期宣告把构建破损逐条自述成清单”核实：rc1-mm5 宣告以清单自述 kbuild 新检查致重复 EXPORT_SYMBOL 告警一片并言“There's probably not a lot of point in reporting this if you see it.”——实录式清单文体在案。

title: 回退补丁的逐版交代
issue: “宣告逐一交代上版问题与回退去向”逐字核实：rc1-mm5 宣告对弃置补丁逐条给“Dropped, had problems.”“Dropped - a bit messy, scary warnings, not very pointful.”等交代。

title: 修复版的发布节奏
issue: 史评框架题：论题“修复版节奏显示低级 bug 清理先于大规模测试”为宣告编年的解读性框架，具体自述（“清掉低级 bug 以便开展认真 MM 测试”）在节料转录层，本轮未回取原帖；离线核查通过（T1／S2／S3）。

title: 树间冲突的弃置判词
issue: “宣告对冲突或破坏稳定的子树直接给出去留判词”核实：rc1-mm5 宣告“Git trees”栏目与逐补丁“Dropped”判词并置，判词文字为合并取舍的直接记录。

title: 深夜评语的现场笔触
issue: “个别宣告留下即时笔触”核实：rc1-mm5 宣告判词“Dropped - a bit messy, scary warnings, not very pointful.”属现场口吻；论题例引“懒得逐一描述”（2.6.15-mm4）出自节料转录，该宣告原帖本轮经 lore 检索与 marc.info（超时）未回取，已列转呈件建议正著引用前核原帖。

title: 系统调用的增撤现场
issue: 编目观察题：论题“宣告中接口增撤记载并置”为宣告档案的料件观察（openat 引入与 unshare 撤销并载），无独立外涉断言；离线核查通过（T1／S2／S3）。

title: 调试接口的定位红线
issue: “维护者为 debugfs 划定只属于调试的红线”逐字核实：官方文档“Debugfs exists as a simple way for kernel developers to make information available to user space”且“debugfs has no rules at all”；Greg KH 2018-10-02 逐字“Stuff in debugfs should NEVER be used for anything 'real' or anything other than debugging.”

title: 迁出流程的缺位之问
issue: “成熟调试接口在关闭 debugfs 的系统上不可用，迁出流程缺位被公开追问并援引先例”逐字核实（Rostedt，ksummit-discuss 2018-10-01）：称 Kernel Recipes 遇“mature interfaces in the debugfs directory, but they can not access them on systems that have debugfs disabled”，问“What would be the process to have these systems move out of debugfs?”并自举 tracefs 先例。

title: 模块参数的旋钮属性
issue: “模块参数被重新解释为调试旋钮而非稳定 ABI”逐字核实（Jani Nikula，同线）：“I think module parameters should primarily be viewed as debug knobs rather than ABI.”并言“all module parameters show up in sysfs”。

title: 兼容顾虑的反方案例
issue: “以廉价硬件依赖非调试参数加载配置为例”逐字核实（Mauro Carvalho Chehab，同线）：廉价媒体设备“sometimes the vendor doesn't put any eeprom at the device, or doesn't care enough to give a PCI or USB ID”，驱动靠模块参数加载正确配置，且 media 子系统“avoid touching the existing parameters……in order to avoid breaking userspace setups”。

title: probe 时序的技术根由
issue: “调试文件须待驱动注册才存在，probe 前生效为模块参数独有便利”逐字核实（Jani Nikula，同线）：“with just a few lines you can add the module parameter, get the sysfs, and have the value be set before probe.”并称“There's nothing that compares, really”。

title: 用户态提案的轨道归位
issue: “用户态文件系统提案被质询讨论场所”逐字核实（Greg KH，ZUFS 线 2018-10-03）：“Why wouldn't this be better discussed at the file-system-specific conference? Or have you already done that this year?”

title: stable 准入的判据清单
issue: “准入判据以成文清单固化”逐字核实（stable-kernel-rules.html）：“It must be obviously correct and tested.”“It cannot be bigger than 100 lines, with context.”且须修“an oops, a hang, data corruption, a real security issue, a hardware quirk, a build error”一类真问题。

title: 回移时机的三案权衡
issue: 论题“提前告知、推迟回传、按 Fixes 延迟回传三种方案被逐案权衡”为论战记录断言：本轮经 lore 多组检索（prevent regressions＋stable backport+Fixes 等）未获原帖；官方文档仅载打标自动回移、Fixes 派生版本与致 stable 列表三条常规路径，不载该三方辩论。已查面如实记录，不编造。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：权衡论战无一手，改落官方三案并附延迟条款〕

title: Fixes 标注的语义之争
issue: 论题“Fixes 应指向前驱提交还是仅指回归存在分歧”之分歧原帖未获回取：lore 多组关键词（Fixes 语义／unfair backport／introduces the bug／iwai）检索均未命中 2024 年论战线；官方口径“a Fixes: tag indicates that the patch fixes a bug in a previous commit”（submitting-patches.html，本轮实测）与题面相容但不构成分歧在案的证明。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：分歧原帖未获，题面收至官方口径〕

title: 评审义务的硬性底线
issue: “维护者对本域补丁负逐件评审义务”逐字核实（feature-and-driver-maintainers.html）：“Maintainers must review all patches touching exclusively their drivers, no matter how trivial.”

title: 条目校验的签名门槛
issue: “名单按签名数与历史活跃度校验”机制核实：get_maintainer.pl 源码实有“--git-min-signatures”（default 1）“--git-fallback”（默认启用）“--git-min-percent”（default 5）诸项，按 git 历史签名计数；“名单可校验性成为治理议题”另有 2022-08“Validating MAINTAINERS entries?”线在案（Hemminger 提案年度探测失效地址，Greg、Brown、Lee Jones 等多帖参与）。

title: Link 标签的格式规范
issue: “Link 标签承载消息溯源职能”逐字核实（submitting-patches.html）：相关讨论在档者加“Link: tags pointing to it”，列表档用 lore.kernel.org 且“use the contents of the Message-ID header of the message without the surrounding angle brackets”。

title: 政策文档的渐进路线
issue: “吸纳维护者设计为渐进过程”逐字核实（rust-for-linux.com/rust-kernel-policy）：“The goal has always been to get maintainers involved progressively, because the effort does not scale otherwise.”

title: 带宽约束的自决空间
issue: “子系统可以带宽不足为由暂缓接纳新语言代码”逐字核实（同页）：“Some subsystems may decide they do not want to have Rust code for the time being, typically for bandwidth reasons.”

title: 行为准则的执行尺度
issue: “执行尺度在‘对人标准一致’与议题定性之间拉锯”逐字核实（ksummit 2023-09“Trust and maintenance of file systems”线）：Bottomley 引 Chinner“No fucking way”称其为“a textbook stress inducing personal attack”、自认“absolutely I see an equivalence”（与 Linus 嘲讽同权），并以“the standard you hold yourself to has to be the same or better than the standard you hold others to”立论；Chinner 坚称议题系社区机器人伤人伦理对策、“has *nothing to do with AI*”。

title: 信任体系的人本立场
issue: “自动化信任与机器署名被明确排除”逐字核实（Torvalds，MAINTAINERS SUMMIT LLM 线 2026-07-22）：“I really don't believe in automated trust systems. They'll just get gamed”，信任“purely personal: I trust submaintainers”，git 签名与 kernel.org 密钥属身份证明层面；另及 Greg 参与的“decentralized trust”项目。

title: 法律风险的容忍判定
issue: 论题“维护者无责与项目整体风险分开评估、容忍度须集体裁量”（DCO(c) 条与大规模回退说）未获一手回取：已入 ksummit 2025-08/09“Annotating patches containing AI-assisted code”线（97 帖）取回 Bottomley 两帖，均为“pure AI generated code is effectively uncopyrightable and therefore public domain”一类论证，DCO(c) 无责与集体风险容忍度表述未命中，已查面如实记录。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：容忍度分工无一手，题面收至法律风险判定〕

title: 界线划分的担责之辩
issue: “边界讨论的共同点是维护者不得为不可控入口被动担责”双源核实：eBPF 边界见 LWN 921088（BPF 长期立场为不向用户空间提供接口稳定保证，Starovoitov 反对 KF_STABLE 并言“must never be a reason not to change something in the kernel”）；Rust 边界见 rust-kernel-policy“The usual kernel policy applies. That is, whoever is the listed maintainer.”

title: regzbot 的追踪串联
issue: “回归追踪机器人以邮件标签接线成闭环”逐字核实（reporting-regressions.html）：“Regzbot works by watching for replies to reports of tracked regressions.”报告侧以“#regzbot”标签接线（如“#regzbot introduced: 1f2e3d4c5d”）。

title: Link 标签的自动接线
issue: “补丁引用报告的 Link 标签被机器人自动接续追踪”逐字核实（同页）：regzbot“looking out for posted or committed patches referencing such reports with 'Link:' tags”——标签由此从引用礼仪升格为追踪基础设施。

title: 修复时限的两周预期
issue: “回归应在两周内修复的预期被写进文档”逐字核实（同页）：“most regressions should be fixed within two weeks.”

title: 集成树的日常聚合
issue: “linux-next 几乎每日聚合全部子系统树”逐字核实（howto.html）：集成测试专用库“virtually all subsystem trees are pulled on an almost daily basis”，给出“summary outlook onto what will be expected to go into the mainline kernel”。

title: 驻留时长的量化复盘
issue: “补丁在 -next 的驻留时长被统计复盘”逐字核实（Sasha Levin，MAINTAINERS SUMMIT 2025-09-11）：其机器人“able to analyze pull requests and respond with statistics about how long commits spent in -next as well as on the mailing lists”，并自述“I haven't ended up receiving signal from Linus that it's useful and not a waste of his time, so I stopped sending these mails out.”

title: 二分定位的方法源流
issue: “mainline、pending-fixes 与 -next 之间的二分方法被要求入档”逐字核实（Mark Brown，linus-next 线 2024-10-22）：自述前帖所讲即“bisecting between mainline<->pending-fixes<->-next rather than between -next versions”，并应允“You're right that we should have that in the documentation somewhere, I'll look at sending a patch.”

title: AI 评审的位置之争
issue: “大规模自动审查已被既成流程接纳”核实（LWN 1049830，2025-12-11）：Torvalds 言工具已用于“identifying CVE candidates and stable-backport candidates”，Starovoitov 称自动评审“producing good reviews about 60% of the time”，Axboe 称“AI always catches that stuff”——新工具纳入工具链之争以既成自动化为底。

title: 文档构建的 Sphinx 管线
issue: “内核文档以 Sphinx 从 reStructuredText 生成”逐字核实（doc-guide/sphinx.html）：“The Linux kernel uses Sphinx to generate pretty documentation from reStructuredText files under Documentation”，构建走“make htmldocs or make pdfdocs”。

title: 逐补丁警告的 CI 闸门

issue: “以自愿加入与维护者自行取舍为规则取向”逐字核实（Stoakes，MAINTAINERS SUMMIT 2025-08-05）：“It's important to get a sense of how maintainers feel about this - whether what is proposed is opt-in or opt-out - and how we actually implement this.”并及按子系统设红绿灯（“a 'traffic light' system per-subsystem”）之议；生成与审查负担不对称见其“to generate as much content that may, on a surface reading, seem valid whilst in reality being quite the opposite”。

title: 报告路径的改革澄清
issue: “报告路径改为按子系统投递维护者”逐字核实（reporting-issues.html）：按 MAINTAINERS 找子系统列表报告，稳定线“Send a short problem report to the Linux stable mailing list (stable@vger.kernel.org) and CC the Linux regressions mailing list”；“一级支持组缺位被承认”出自 Leemhuis 自述（节料转录层），官方文档面与之相容。

title: 警告编年的报告洪流
issue: “报料由警告文本主动征募”逐字核实（2002-05-02 报料，lkml.iu.edu 档）：内核警告原文“unexpected IO-APIC, please mail to linux-smp@vger.kernel.org”，报料者附寄存器读数与平台细节（双 Xeon 82870P2、I/O APIC #2 register #00 reads 02008000）；报料方法与版本号纪律见官方 apic= 参数文档（quiet／verbose／debug 调试输出档位）。

title: 触发全景的个案清点
issue: 编目设计题：论题“二十余例报料覆盖 workstation 到大机架”为本节报料料件的清点框架（触发场景编目），非独立外涉断言；报告样本真实性已抽验（2002-05 双 Xeon 82870P2、2002-12 双 Xeon HT 两帖在档）；离线核查通过（T1／S2／S3）。

title: 定时器接线的 BIOS 缺陷
issue: “MP 表谎报定时器中断”逐字核实（内核源码 io_apic.c 注释，本轮实测）：“There is a nasty bug in some older SMP boards, their mptable lies about the timer IRQ.”

title: 中断级联的误报路径
issue: “级联 8259A 被固件误报为定时器输入”逐字核实（同源码注释）：“Some BIOS writers are clueless and report the ExtINTA I/O APIC input from the cascaded 8259A as the timer interrupt input.”

title: noapic 兜底的治理个案
issue: “noapic 作为平台不适配的长期兜底处方”核实：官方启动参数文档实载参数族“apic [APIC,X86-64] Use IO-APIC. Default.”（noapic 条目在同文件，本轮页面截断未及逐字引用，特注）；2.4.19 更新日志逐字“disable APIC when broken mptable is found”（hch）；2002-05 报料线程实测报告平台不适配个案。

title: 维护者定调的方法记录
issue: 论题引语“警告无大碍”与“勘误内核优先”（先升 errata 内核）的维护者定调帖未获一手回取：已查 lkml.iu.edu（WebSearch 组词）、WebSearch 多轮、marc.info（连接超时三轮）；报告线程本身在档（2002-05、2002-12 报料帖实测）。已查面如实记录，不编造。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：定调帖未获，题面改查证记录〕

title: 白名单语义的权威定性
issue: 定性原帖就地取回（本机 lkml 存档库实测）：Randy Dunlap 2001-07-16（message-id 3B534B36.3A69DBF@osdlab.org）逐字——“You are right about the noisy message(s). The newer IO APICs aren't in the kernel's known devices list yet.”——即“硬件不在已知清单”而非故障提示；另有 2003-06-24 Dunlap 补丁帖（message-id 20030624161003.20fbbbd4.rddunlap@osdl.org）逐字“Oh, and the UNEXPECTED_IO_APIC() function doesn't print anything in 2.5.current and I didn't change that.”，与报料者 Greg Norris 2003-06-16 实测“dmesg no longer shows any『unexpected IO-APIC』messages”互证不再打印。注：论题“终结了多年的误读”属史学解读、不作实证断言。〔2026-11-03 存疑解除：本机 lkml 存档库直取原帖〕

title: 版本家族的编目口径
issue: “0x14、0x20 版本号家族在报料中被反复编目”双源核实：源码注释逐字“IO-APIC versions below 0x20 don't support EOI register.”（现代 io_apic.c 实测）；报料一手示例——2002-05 帖“I/O APIC # 2 Version 32”（即 0x20 家族），2002-12 帖“Processor #0 Pentium 4(tm) XEON(tm) APIC version 20”（即 0x14）。

title: 文档讹误的勘误链条
issue: “芯片组手册把 IO-APIC 版本写成 0x2 的讹误被源码注释勘正”逐字核实（io_apic.c 注释，本轮实测）：“Some of the Intel ICH Specs (ICH2 to ICH5) documents the io-apic version as 0x2. This is an error with documentation and these ICH chips use io-apic's of version 0x20.”

title: SiS 平台的兼容困境
issue: 论题“Alan Cox 裁定 2.4 尚不支持 SiS APIC、已从 SiS 拿到资料但未回移”未获一手回取：已查 ChangeLog-2.4.19（SiS 条目仅 IDE 数据损坏移除、sisfb／sis900；“disable APIC when broken mptable is found”与“dmi now handles boxes where apic enabling is bad”在案）、ChangeLog-2.4.21（SiS 仅音效／sisfb／SIS5513 IDE）、2002-03 SiS 平台报料帖（SiS5513 挂起，2.2.x 正常）；SiS＋APIC 专项裁定帖未命中。已查面如实记录。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：裁定与供料由本机 LKML 档两帖逐字确认〕

title: 措辞修订的版本分界
issue: 论题“2.4.21 起新版措辞要求附完整信息”未获一手回取：ChangeLog-2.4.21 仅有 Mikael Pettersson“update unexpected IO APIC detection”条目（检测逻辑变更，本轮实测），措辞变更无载；tglx/history 仓库 v2.4.21 ref 404、refs 页超时、marc.info 超时，2.4.21 版 io_apic.c 未能取回。已证面为 2002-05 原始措辞“unexpected IO-APIC, please mail to linux-smp@vger.kernel.org”。〔2026-11-03 存疑清零：2.4.21 变更无一手，题面收至原始文本〕

title: 警告与回归的同机绑定
issue: 个案线程就地取回（本机 lkml 存档库实测）：Greg Norris 2003-06-03“lost interrupts with 2.4.1-rc6 and i875p chipset”（message-id 20030603111519.GA23228@glitch.localdomain，正文为 2.4.21-rc6、i875P/82875P，2.4.20 无此问题）；2003-06-04 其结论逐字“After a bit of experimenting with pre7, I found that I only need to disable IOAPIC (ACPI was already disabled)”；2003-06-16 复述“I just finished testing rc7, and sure enough the problem disappears after disabling APIC”；Dunlap 2003-06-24 补丁帖佐证“Most of the most recent ones are due to some newer Intel chipsets (865, 875)”。启用 IO-APIC 即丢中断、禁用即稳定与 rc7 两成分均获一手。〔2026-11-03 存疑解除：本机 lkml 存档库直取〕

title: DRM 层的统一接口
issue: “DRM 以统一接口承担内存管理与 DMA 等事务”逐字核实（gpu/introduction.html，本轮实测）：“The Linux DRM layer contains code intended to support the needs of complex graphics devices……make tasks like memory management, interrupt handling and DMA easier, and provide a uniform interface to applications.”

title: 加速器剥离的动机
issue: “为防图形软件栈把加速器当 GPU 使用”逐字核实（accel/introduction.html，本轮实测）：“Because we want to prevent the extensive user-space graphic software stack from trying to use an accelerator as a GPU”。

title: 机器学习负载的归类
issue: “计算加速器以机器学习与深度学习负载为主要设计对象”逐字核实（同页）：“Although these devices are typically designed to accelerate Machine-Learning (ML) and/or Deep-Learning (DL) computations”。

title: 新主设备号的隔离安排
issue: “加速器以新主设备号与独立字符设备文件同 GPU 区隔”逐字核实（同页）：“the compute accelerators will be differentiated from GPUs by using a new major number and new device char files.”

title: 依托 DRM 的协作路径
issue: “加速器核心代码并入 DRM 子系统、设备作为新型 DRM 设备存在”逐字核实（同页）：“the accel core code will be part of the DRM subsystem and an accel device will be a new type of DRM device.”

title: 开放用户态的门槛争议
issue: “uAPI 原则以开放用户态对应为门槛”逐字核实（drm-uapi.html，本轮实测）：“any addition of DRM uAPI requires corresponding open-sourced userspace patches”且 patches 须先经上游评审；直通分歧见 LWN 990802（fwctl 会话：Torvalds 定“baseline such as fwctl……no random DMA”底线、跨子系统 nack 与 RDMA 先例之辩）。

title: 议题入场的时点背景
issue: 题面无外部断言，属体例／编目题，离线核查与目录层级（第 4 章 4.1“GPL 执法与法律史料”）无冲突；但题面未点明议题对象，“时点背景”两层抽象叠加，读者只看目录难辨所指。thesis 三项断言经一手核对无误：Sandler 提案原文列“Patrick McHardy's enforcement, the Principles of Community Oriented Enforcement, VMware dismissal/appeal”，Kuhn 称“a confluence of external events already did that without my help”；社区导向执法原则见 SFC 原则页“Legal action is a last resort”。建议题面补出对象。

title: 违规数据的量化口径
issue: 千分之五点七即 0.57%，系 Kuhn 自述口径：其档内邮件脚注“reports of at least 3,000 GPL violations in my life, and I count only 17 defendants who have ever been sued”，17÷3000＝0.567%，与 thesis 数值相符；同线程 Allison 以“your 0.57% or however you define it”质疑口径，与“量化口径本身成为争点”相符。取证说明：lore.kernel.org 本会话不可达（WebFetch 连接超时；exa 取回为 Anubis 验证页“Making sure you're not a bot!”），故以内库全量邮件档核对（档内＝03-原始史料库/11-邮件列表史料/05-linux-kernel/db，含完整信体与 message-id），未以二手转述代替原文。

title: 诉讼路线的定调之语
issue: Linus 原话“Let's be clear about this: lawsuits destroy. They don't ‘protect’.”（2016-08-26，message-id CA+55aFxLRqket8-yCL=FPM0Bz86PxdS+hRSTzXES+=1bOv=feg@mail.gmail.com），LWN 转引“Lawsuits destroy community. They destroy trust.”；同线程另有“What I care about is getting code contributions back. That's kind of the whole *point* of the GPLv2.”，与 thesis 两项断言相符。题面无硬伤；惟“诉讼路线”易读作已采纳诉讼路线（实为否定诉讼取向），可酌改。

title: 治理追问的三方并置
issue: thesis 把三方定为“机构、维护者到开发者”，与一手不合：Ts'o 的追问轴为 Conservancy／版权持有公司／开发者，原话“Ah, but *which* developers?… What about the companies that own copyright in the Linux kernel, such as Red Hat, IBM, Intel, Google, and others? Do they get a seat at the table?”；LWN 归纳的争议三方则是 SFC、Linus 与 Ts'o，其中并无独立的“维护者”一方。题面“三方并置”亦未点名三方，属悬空。建议题面改指授权归属，并在 thesis 更正主体。〔已采纳落账 2026-11-02〕

title: 雇佣结构的权利之问
issue: Rodriguez 原话“can a Linux developer working for a company really care about GPL enforcement or has this right been taken away by a lot of companies”，与 thesis“受雇开发者能否真正关心执法的权利之问”逐点相符；同线程 Greg KH 对雇佣结构的回应见 #347082（“And if you work for a company, you can be seen as a company representative and all sorts of other things come into play very quickly.”）。题面无硬伤，与同节 4.1.4 句式一致。

title: tracepoint 的 ABI 之辩
issue: 2016-09 线程一手：Shuah Khan 提案引出分歧，线程折中为“a set of tracepoints that are only enabled if one adds to the kernel command line ‘this-kernel-is-broken’”，题面“ABI 之辩”属实。惟 thesis“折中成为定调”未获成文政策支撑：本会话查 Documentation 的 tracepoints 与 events 两页，均无 tracepoint ABI 稳定性表述，宜降为“线程内折中”。

title: 字段既成的事实 ABI
issue: 线程引 `TRACE_EVENT(sched_switch)` 的 `__field(long, prev_state)`，并称“struct task_struct::state is long but it looks like a historical artifact, it can be just int”，Rostedt 答“tracepoints can change”，与 thesis“历史遗留字段被工具依赖而事实成 ABI”相符。题面可读，惟“既成的事实 ABI”四字连缀略生，可酌改。

title: 发行版携带的现实负担
issue: Jan Kara（SUSE）原话“On top of 4.4.19 we currently carry some 4700 patches which together add/delete some 390k lines. Out of these some 280 patches are not backports of upstream patches”，与 thesis“携带数千补丁的实测数据”相符；同线程另有 chromeos-4.4“5,594 patches”对照。题面“现实负担”偏泛，可按 thesis 收紧。

title: 保序与时间戳的重排
issue: Rostedt 原话“When ordering is not ensured, then we can force timestamps. And I like the idea of the time stamp happening when the printk is called, not when it actually goes to the buffer. That way, we could see the timestamps out of order, and sequence them during postmortem.”，与 thesis 逐点相符，题面无硬伤。

title: 崩溃输出的卸载禁区
issue: Senozhatsky 原话“kthread offloading during panic() is really risky… that's why we disable printk offloading when in panic() - we don't want to make the things any worse.”，与 thesis“panic 路径禁用卸载被论证为禁区”相符。题面“卸载”承项目既有译法指 offloading（非模块卸载），在“崩溃输出”限定下可读通。

title: 缺陷跟踪的渠道清点
issue: Leemhuis 逐条清点 MAINTAINERS 的 B: 行：总 70，mailto 12、bugzilla 23、github 17、gitlab 11（原信列命令与计数），与 thesis“报告渠道被逐条清点、邮件与缺陷库并行”相符；题面无硬伤。

title: 邮件通用语的辩护词
issue: Linus 原话“Guess what that ‘add develooper to the Cc’ is called? Email.”，并断言“you really should consider email to be the ‘lingua franca’ of kernel development communication”，同时斥缺陷库邮件集成为“TOTAL HORROR-SHOW to manage… without bugzilla becoming a prime way to send spam”，与 thesis 逐点相符；现行报告文档亦称“Linux kernel development is completely driven by mail.”

title: 验证内核的发行方实践
issue: Kosina（SUSE）原话“we do a ‘Kernel of the day’ build of a branch that follows Linus' tree… in an optional package repository. That allows the reporter to easily check whether the issue has been fixed in latest upstream without needing to have the skills required to compile own kernel.”，与 thesis 相符。题面“验证内核的发行方实践”中“验证内核”易读成动宾，可作“发行方的验证内核实践”。

title: 私下报告的告诫定则
issue: Geert Uytterhoeven 原话“Never send bug reports privately, unless you have a monetary relationship with the receiving end. Always Cc the subsystem mailing list, so anyone involved can help.”，与 thesis“切勿私下报障、抄送列表成为硬性预期”相符；现行报告文档亦载“do not contact any of the developers privately about it”。

title: 行宽约束的物理边界
issue: Mauro 原话“a single line can easily have more than 998 characters”（并称造成部分邮件服务器拒收补丁）、“two patches were silently rejected by the VGER server”，与 thesis“静默拒收构成提交的物理边界”逐点相符；998 与 RFC 5322 行宽上限一致。

title: 报告文档的全文张贴
issue: Leemhuis 原话“For easier review I'll post the text of reporting-issues.rst in reply to this mail. I'll do that in a few chunks, as if this was a cover letter for a patch-set.”，并宣布下个合并窗口删除 reporting-bugs.rst 使其正式化，与 thesis 相符；题面无硬伤。

title: 文档冗长的自评瘦身
issue: Leemhuis 自评原话“I really hope we over time can shorten that text somewhat (or even a lot?)”，并计划“hiding some things in a reporting app… that only bothers reporters with tainted status, bisection, decoding of stack-traces”，与 thesis 逐点相符；题面无硬伤。

title: 稳定报告的地址定则
issue: Greg KH 原话“‘stable@vger.kernel.org’ is good to use here, no need to also cc: any individuals for this type of thing.”，与 thesis“只发 stable 列表、改个人抄送为固定渠道”相符。惟现行文档已补“ideally also CC the maintainer and the mailing list for the subsystem in question”，属后续修正，宜在辨析中记明，勿使题面读作现行唯一渠道。

title: 静态检查的入库实录

Note that it's not a straight import all modern BSDs have a lot of changes over the old 4.4BSD version we're using.”；底本辨析属实。

title: 署名惯例的源流对照
issue: 一手：G. Branden Robinson 2025-05-09 linux-man“Re: Removing in-source contribution records”：“AUTHORS”文件列版权持有人、“THANKS”文件致谢未持版权者，并称此与 GNU 做法一致；统一署名方案与既有惯例的对照属实。

title: TAB 选举的提名程序
issue: 三要素均获一手：2024-09-01 征选通告载自荐投递地址“tech-board-discuss@lists.linux.dev”、自述“a short (<= 200 words) statement”与“The nomination deadline is 17:00 CET (GMT + 2) on September 20.”；2024-09-26 转发的开票通告列 11 名被提名人（Amit Shah、Dan Williams、Daniel Borkmann、Dave Hansen、Jakub Kicinski、Jiri Kosina、Kees Cook、Lorenzo Pieralisi、Miguel Ojeda、Ricardo Neri、Shuah Khan）并称“Voting will remain open through September 27.”，投票经 CIVS（civs1.civs.us）。题面“提名、CIVS 投票与截止时点”逐项对应。

title: 投票资格的提交门槛
issue: 2021 年通告逐字：“you must have at least three commits in a mainline or stable released kernel”，须“Have a commit date in the year 2020 or 2021”，并“Contain an e-mail address in one of the following tags or merged tags”之 Signed-off-by／Tested-by／Reported-by／Reviewed-by／Acked-by；投票窗“September 20th to September 23rd 16:00 GMT-4 (US/Eastern)”；“more than 50 commits”自动获票、3–49 次须申请。与史料（三个带标签提交、9 月 23 日 16:00 GMT-4 截止）逐点吻合。

title: 署名规则的成文之辩
issue: Ts'o 2020-12-03 原文先定调“I don't think there should be any kind of fixed, inflexible rules about this.”，继以四点：①“Do we really want to require links to dozens of mail message id's”；②“Sometimes a fixup is pretty trivial”；③“this very much should be up to the maintainer's discretion”；④“It's really unhealthy, in my opinion for people to be fixed on counting attributions.”，并明言固定规则会诱发人们对 Signed-off-by 计数的游戏化。与史料“四点反对＋counting attributions 被灌水游戏化”逐项对应。

title: 回移门槛的署名标准
issue: Carpenter 2020-12-09 原文：“How about we make the standard, ‘Would this fix be backported to stable?’”，随后以 signedness 两修法（“if (ret < 0 || ret < unsigned_long_size)” 对 “if (ret < (int)unsigned_long_size)”）为例，并以“commit f026d8ca2904 ("igc: add support to eeprom, registers and link self-tests")”说明修复署名。该 commit 经本地 Linux 镜像核实：f026d8ca2904622298c5387c384dce04f119e87a，Vitaly Lifshits，2020-05-05，题名逐字相同。回移判断与署名标准捆绑成立。

title: 认证记录的留存义务
issue: 题名维持（复核首选方案：换史料保原题）——留存义务一手在 DCO 第 (d) 项，现引 reporting-issues.rst 转正 TL;DR 与论题后句不合，归证据批换锚。

title: 测试求证的用户动员
issue: kernel.org 存档 announce.txt 逐字：“Again, we'd like people who have had recent DRM and USB resume problem to test and report, please.”；同件首条为“Mainly a bunch of fixes relative to 2.6.12-rc1-mm2.”。宣告直接点名受影响用户请其测试验证，题面“用户动员成为发布流程的固定动作”成立（同月 Rafael J. Wysocki 的回帖即以其为测试号召作答）。

title: 修复摘要的体例样本
issue: Chris Wright 2005-11-24 原文：“We (the -stable team) are announcing the release of the 2.6.14.3 kernel.”“The diffstat and short summary of the fixes are below.”；diffstat 总计“32 files changed, 177 insertions(+), 74 deletions(-)”；摘要逐条列“PPTP helper: Fix endianness bug in GRE key / CallID NAT”“ip_conntrack: fix ftp/irc/tftp helpers on ports >= 32768”“x86_64/i386: Compute correct MTRR mask on early Noconas”“Fix soft lockup with ALSA rtc-timer”，与史料四项吻合。

title: 补丁跟帖的无言范式
issue: 2006-01-14 宣告明言“I'll also be replying to this message with a copy of the patch between 2.6.15 and 2.6.15.1, as it is small enough to do so.”；2006-01-15 02:00:54 EST 的跟帖（Chris Wright）正文首行即“diff --git a/Makefile b/Makefile”，此前无一句评语，全文为 2.6.15→2.6.15.1 补丁。题面“diff 即内容”成立。

title: 架构破坏的点名警示
issue: 2008-04-10 原文逐条：“Compilation is busted on mips due to the page-flags patches”“Compilation is busted on sparc64 due to the page-flags patches”“Compilation is partially busted on powerpc due to the page-flags patches. It compiles for my g5 but allmodconfig fails.”；剔除项“git-drm is dropped due to build errors”“git-xfs is dropped due to failure to get a clean git diff”“git-kvm is dropped due to clashes with git-s390”；代班“git-slub has been temporarily replaced by git-pekka. Pekka is standing in while Christoph is away.”。与史料逐项对应。唯 thesis 末句“请人验证”在本件无对应句（同件只写“x86 works for me, but Rafael is reporting some crashes”），属细节过述，不影响题面。

title: 冻结期的灌入记录
issue: 2007-10-11 原文：“I've been largely avoiding applying anything since rc8-mm2 in an attempt to stabilise things for the 2.6.23 merge.”“But that didn't stop all the subsystem maintainers from going nuts, with the usual accuracy. We're up to a 37MB diff now, but it seems to be working a bit better.”；同件分节含“PM QoS interface”“FUSE updates”，容器补丁被撤（“-containersv10-basic-container-framework.patch”）。题面成立；唯“灌入”带贬义口吻，宜核与全卷学术语域一致。

title: 分布式版本控制的创生动因
issue: git-scm 正史页逐字：“In 2005, the relationship between the community that developed the Linux kernel and the commercial company that developed BitKeeper broke down, and the tool's free-of-charge status was revoked. This prompted the Linux development community (and in particular Linus Torvalds, the creator of Linux) to develop their own tool based on some of the lessons they learned while using BitKeeper.”。事实层成立；但本行史料（405.14.6 黑名单经济批判）与题无关，四源合成实为单源，落盘前宜换 Git 创生一手。

title: 大型项目的设计目标
issue: 同页目标清单逐字：“Speed”“Simple design”“Strong support for non-linear development (thousands of parallel branches)”“Fully distributed”“Able to handle large projects like the Linux kernel efficiently (speed and data size)”。题面与 thesis 三项（速度、非线性分支、大规模仓库）对应；同 4.9.1，本行史料（405.14.5 tests repo 聚合构想）与题无关，属四源错配，宜换料。

title: 静态检查的实测辩护
issue: 技术实质经一手链核实：sparse 报“incorrect type in argument 3 (different base types) @@ expected int ioerror @@ got restricted blk_status_t [usertype] error”（drivers/block/null_blk/main.c:1577）；该告警所指为真缺陷，先被“null_blk: cast command status to integer”（c5eafd790e1，2021）以强制转换掩盖，终以“block: change blk_mq_add_to_batch() third argument type to bool”（9bce6b5f898，Shin'ichiro Kawasaki，2025-03-11）改正，其提交说明称“the revised check fails to function as intended”。题“实测辩护”成立；唯 thesis 所称“Torvalds 详析自制 sparse 补丁”一节，lore 全域 403 未能取回原线程，属未复核细节。

title: 提交标识的跨树功能
issue: 官方文档 Option 3 逐字：“you must note the upstream commit ID in the changelog of your submission with a separate line above the commit text, like this: commit <sha1> upstream.”“Or alternatively: [ Upstream commit <sha1> ]”，据此他树可据标识符判定主线条目是否已合入；史料侧 Hiramatsu 2014-06-06 亦主张测试套件可“git log | grep <commit-id>”自判补丁是否合入。跨树复用成立。

title: 弃用机制的现状之叹
issue: hpa 2014-06-10 原文逐字：“I second this. Right now deprecation is entirely ad hoc... usually in the form ‘this hasn't compiled for X releases and noone noticed’, which makes it hard to do *controlled* deprecation...”“I realize this is a third rail kind of topic, but it puts us in really hard spots as a project, sometime.”，正为附议 Konrad 的弃用政策提案。与史料“ad hoc／third rail 之叹”逐句对应。取证说明：lore.kernel.org 本会话 403（云主机连接超时，exa 报 SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE），改以本库全量邮件档核对原始信体与 message-id。

title: 语言对比的越界之争
issue: Pinchart 2021-07-08 原文：“You're comparing apples and pears though. A C++ function that is meant to transfer unique ownership of an object to the caller should return a std::unique_ptr<> on a container that stores the data. We're getting off-topic though, this mail thread isn't about comparing C++ and rust”，正回应 Ojeda 以 std::span 举 UB 之例。与史料“苹果比梨”“回到语言本身适配”逐点对应；题面“越界之争”即原文“off-topic”之意。

title: 无用户驱动的评审僵局
issue: Airlie 原文列两难：“a) posting complete series crossing subsystems, people get pissed off and won't review because it's too much”“b) posting series for review that don't have a full user in the series, people get pissed off because of lack of users.”“We are mostly moving forward with (b) initially”；Geert 认可两步法：先“Send the patch set as it is.”，再“Point out to Git tree with branch containing the patches + patches for e.g. driver (hopefully for something that QEMU is able to emulate)”，答以“Exactly.”。与史料三点对应。

title: 类型安全的驱动实证
issue: Wedson 原文逐字：“The ‘writeb’ variant only works when we know at compile-time that the offset is within bounds (the compiler will reject the code otherwise).”；“In Rust we prevent this by not exposing drvdata directly to drivers, and using type-specialised functions to set/get drvdata, so it *knows* that the type is right.”；“By having these checks we guarantee that anyone can hold a reference to device state, but they can no longer use hw resources after the device is removed.”；“After revoking access, we need to ensure that existing concurrent users finish before we can free resources. In this implementation, we use RCU”。对象为 PL061 GPIO 移植件（Ojeda v7 系列第 24 件），题面三项对应。

title: 工具链的打包诉求
issue: Ojeda 原文：“supporting ‘core’ and ‘alloc’ is easier (and it is the only thing we need for the kernel)”；“Distros could distribute the Rust toolchain they used to build the kernel as a separate package; for the kernel only. This is what I would recommend.”。与史料（内核只需 core 与 alloc、发行版为内核单独打包工具链）逐点对应。

title: 惰性比喻的代际焦虑
issue: Walleij 2022-06-22 原文：先引 Bottomley“This really is a creeping cancer of inertia that has destroyed many projects before us”并答“I agree.”，继以 Parkinson《Parkinson's Law》（1957）“age of wisdom”之后是“age of obstruction”之说，落点为“Rust is nice. Let's merge it and see what happens.”与“My biggest worry is that the kernel community can become irrelevant for young people as a demographic.”“So I see it as partly an inclusion problem.”。与史料（惰性癌症比喻、担心失去年轻人）逐句对应，题面“代际焦虑”有原文支撑。

title: 细粒度披露的规则取向
issue: 现行政策以用途分界落地：Out of Scope 列“Spelling and grammar fix ups”“Typing aids like identifier completion”“Purely mechanical transformations”“Reformatting”，In Scope 以“a meaningful amount of content … was not written by a person in the Signed-off-by chain”为界；史料侧 Lorenzo Stoakes 2025-08-05 原文：“we have to be careful not to have a broad-brush approach like ‘no AI’, as there are uses that do not cause issues of concern but are of great use to people using them.”。题面成立。注：起草方所引“Basic development tools (git, gcc, make, editors) should not be listed.”未见于现行 generated-content.rst，疑出草案版本，宜换现行文本。

title: 审查发现的公开跟踪
issue: 2026-08-30 通告逐字：“like syzbot for fuzzer-found bugs, this platform provides an automated tracking layer for AI-reported bugs”“This requires no extra effort from maintainers”，并载“Jason's idea of delegating fixes could also be implemented on this platform”；Gunthorpe 2026-07-18 原帖亦以“So in my mind this is more like syzkaller”立意。与题“公共看板跟踪、不阻塞提交者、可委派”对应。

title: 抄袭推定的从严基调
issue: hpa 2025-12-08 原文逐字：“I contend there is a huge difference between *code* and descriptions/documentation/...”“AI bug reports? We have gotten robot bug reports for decades. Translation tool? Not a problem.”“However, *code* taken out of an AI seems to me that it would have to be presumed plagiarized. Furthermore, it is very often wrong in both subtle and blatant ways.”。推定为抄袭、从严、与翻译类用途区别三点俱全，题面成立。

title: 审查模型的本地实测
issue: LWN 2026-07-21 记“There are some developers looking into ways of running tools like Sashiko locally, using open-weight models; Mauro Carvalho Chehab and Takashi Iwai have mentioned such efforts.”并引 Iwai“Yes, there are definitely many false-positives, and they don't always follow the recent changes.”；档内 Chehab 主张产出“a patch-review kernel-trained model with a couple of different sizes (and kv compression), in GGUF format”，Tso 以内存档位分类（含“16GB of VRAM in your GPU”）。“算力分档＋本地实测”成立；唯史料所称“36B 参数 3-4B 激活、qwen 3.6 于 16GB 显卡”之具体型号与参数未获一手，属未复核细节。

title: 算力捐赠的现实约束
issue: Tso 2026-07-17 原文：“What will we do when the current round of corporate generosity ends and that tool goes away?”；Chehab 答“This is a serious concern. Sounds risky to rely on that, as there's no free lunch. We need to rely on something that can be managed in an affordable way”；LWN 2026-07-21 记“these tools depend heavily on the willingness of corporations to fund their use”，并引 Gushchin“relying on infrastructure provided by a single company without clear formal guarantees”。题“算力捐赠的现实约束”成立。

title: malloc 统一的接口设想
issue: Wilcox 2026-06-29《[TECH TOPIC] Implementing malloc》原文：“malloc() is a standard part of the C library. Yet we force new Linux programmers to learn the difference between vmalloc(), kmalloc() and kvmalloc().”“This topic proposes that we should implement malloc() and calloc().”“This will also benefit Rust as we can use the same infrastructure to implement std::alloc.”，并称将讨论失败语义等边界情形。与题“以 malloc 一类接口屏蔽分配器细节、易用性入议程”逐点对应。

title: 缓冲头退役的性能账
issue: Chinner 2023-09-19 原文逐字：“single file write throughput on a pcie4.0 ssd went from ~2.5GB/s consuming 5 CPUs in mapping lock contention to saturating the device at over 7GB/s whilst also providing a 70% reduction in total CPU usage”，并称“a bufferhead - it uses 56 bytes of memory per fielsystem block that is cached”。三项数据与史料逐字吻合（原文拼写“fielsystem”“reduce reducing”照录不改）。

title: 加速器的分层接口
issue: Vetter 2021-09-14 原文：“I think even for these you might want a drm style uapi, where drm/sched takes different jobs and hammers them into hw in a kernel thread. Ofc it all depends what the programming model is, and something more fixed like media might make sense.”；并批 misc 下绕过评审：“there's another driver in misc which managed to bypass review of two subsystem, not just one”。按编程模型分层（MMIO 型走 drm/sched、固定功能走 media 式）与 misc 批评两点俱全。

title: 对象缓存的适用分界
issue: 官方文档逐字：“If you need to allocate many identical objects you can use the slab cache allocator. The cache should be set up with kmem_cache_create() …”，与题“同型对象用对象缓存分配”一致。唯本行史料（405.24.12 C 聚合传递与内存模型、UB 与 TS 6010）与题无关，属四源错配，落盘前宜换料为分配器指南或 slab 文档。

title: 生命周期的回收统一
issue: Bottomley 2021-07-07 原文：“If we delayed deallocation to module release, that would fix the interrupt issue, wouldn't it? Perhaps all devres memory for devices should live until then anyway and thus be automatically deallocated instead of needing an explicit free”，并称“module lifetime must always encompass the de[vice lifetime]”，其出发点正是“interrupt handlers that are left live longer than they should be and try to use things that were already deallocated”。与史料三项（模块生命周期覆盖设备生命周期、devm 内存延至模块释放回收、消除中断处理器 UAF）逐点对应。
